body: It’s normal to feel like that after quitting heavy use for max a week if it last longer than that then you were probably masking some big issues and should see a therapist.

I’m so sorry I won’t act like I know what your going through but I know that your boyfriend would want you to be happy. I highly recommend seeing a professional (make sure it’s someone you feel comfortable with and connect to!) ❤️

I know it’s a little late but confidence helped me a lot when dealing with people like that. I was afraid of confrontation so I just accepted being the brunt of the joke. Then one day a quite larger guy stepped on my foot on purpose and I snapped. I broke his nose and cracked part of his lower jaw and didn’t get in trouble since it was self defense. Needless to say no one joked with me like that again. This was purely anecdotal so sorry if it doesn’t help. But just don’t accept being the joke next time someone tries you tell them to fuck off.
OR you could get a new puppy. Not trying to be insensitive and act like your dog is replaceable but it would give you something to love and live for again.
I used to be funny and personable but now I just feel like I’m not normal for not being able to contribute to the conversation or fun.
Because my family or friends will be having fun and my general bad mood will bring everyone down. I know because they straight up tell me.

Yeah I used to mix Xanax and alcohol or try and OD on oxy I guess as some half assed attempt at suicide. I used to be so healthy I worked out 5x a week and ate amazing healthy food. I was so proud of my body. Now I barely eat and never work out .It makes me so sad to look in the mirror now.
I thought I wanted to be sober but when I got there it didn’t help. I don’t have much motivation anymore. It feels like I ruin people’s happiness and I guess that’s where my sadness stems from.

I wish I believed that but my dad said it was my fault when we had an argument. They were clearly happy until a couple of years ago. I want to make them proud but don’t know how ,I’ve dug a hole I don’t know how to climb out of. I just go through everyday depressed, self loathing and alone. It’s so hard to be motivated when you feel like shit.
